items.summary: OKXICE's public notice dated 5 November 2026 lists Notices of Issuer Objection from 67 issuers, including Meta Platforms and Palantir Technologies, according to the document published by OKXICE. The notice follows earlier reporting that disclosed objections had risen to 56 companies. Kryptovalutaguiden covered the update.

items.summary: Tesla, SpaceX, Amazon, Netflix, SoFi and Lam Research are among the companies that have objected to their shares being offered as tokens on OKXICE. According to CoinDesk, Decrypt and CoinMarketCap, the number of disclosed objections rose from 50 in a notice on 30 October to 56 in a notice on 2 November. By CoinDesk's tally, 49 of 62 companies have objected.
